item: P2-116 (board F39#13) Tidewake camp workbench identity
made_by: Visual lane (Claude), 3 Nov 2026, Blender 4.2.3 LTS, procedural build; no Meshy, no external assets
reference: Drafted reference (text): a seaside camp carpenter's bench. A long three-plank top (2.6 m x 1.05 m at 0.95 m) on thick legs with a lower shelf; behind it a 2.15 m tool board with a hammer, a saw, tongs and a rope coil hung on brass pegs, spaced so each reads alone; an iron vise at one end; a plank workpiece, mallet, brass jar and folded teal sail on the top; a 2.6 m lantern post at the other end. Warm brown wood, iron, brass, rope, teal. No red or oxblood. Answers the GPU WD2 judges' path: 'a larger work surface with clear tools'.
scale_check: source/scale_check.jpg: the bench beside a 1.80 m cylinder (the trainer). Top at 0.95 m (hip height), tool board top 2.15 m and lantern post 2.6 m stand above the trainer so the station reads past a trainer standing in front of it.
